parameters.content: Periodic review triage scan. Queries PromptForge state for review-required prompt generations, failed deliveries, and errored intake notes, then emits a compact summary payload suitable for a future Obsidian or notification adapter.

parameters.query:
SELECT 'prompt_generation_review' AS review_kind,
       pg.id AS record_id,
       i.note_relative_path,
       COALESCE(p.slug, 'inbox') AS project_slug,
       pg.status,
       d.status AS delivery_status,
       NULL::text AS error_text
FROM prompt_generations pg
LEFT JOIN utterances u ON u.id = pg.utterance_id
LEFT JOIN intake_notes i ON i.id = u.intake_note_id
LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = pg.project_id
LEFT JOIN deliveries d ON d.prompt_generation_id = pg.id
WHERE pg.requires_review = TRUE
UNION ALL
SELECT 'delivery_failed' AS review_kind,
       d.id AS record_id,
       i.note_relative_path,
       COALESCE(p.slug, 'inbox') AS project_slug,
       pg.status,
       d.status AS delivery_status,
       d.error_text
FROM deliveries d
JOIN prompt_generations pg ON pg.id = d.prompt_generation_id
LEFT JOIN utterances u ON u.id = pg.utterance_id
LEFT JOIN intake_notes i ON i.id = u.intake_note_id
LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = pg.project_id
WHERE d.status = 'failed'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'intake_error' AS review_kind,
       i.id AS record_id,
       i.note_relative_path,
       COALESCE(p.slug, 'inbox') AS project_slug,
       i.status,
       NULL::text AS delivery_status,
       NULL::text AS error_text
FROM intake_notes i
LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id
WHERE i.status = 'error'
ORDER BY review_kind, note_relative_path;
